case_number: 2023 INSC 643; TRANSFER PETITION (CIVIL) NO. 1770 OF 2021, TRANSFER PETITION (CRIMINAL) NO. 659 OF 2019
summary: Matrimonial dispute involving multiple concurrent proceedings; transfer petitions filed by wife seeking consolidation of cases in Himachal Pradesh; husband opposed transfer of criminal case under IPC s.323, s.341, s.498A pending at Jaisalmer; court held matrimonial cases prioritize wife's convenience under s.25 CPC/s.406 CrPC; exceptions apply only for glaring facts; irrelevant comparisons to Jyoti Mishra (other accused parties) and Nahar Singh Yadav (serious CBI cases); no prejudice given husband already attending proceedings in Solan; transfer granted with exemption from personal appearance; all cases consolidated in Solan district for efficiency.
legal_provisions_cited: Hindu Adoption and Maintenance Act, 1956 s.18
Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.323, s.341, s.498A
final_judgment: Transfer petitions allowed; divorce petition and criminal case transferred to Solan district courts; personal appearance exemption granted to husband; cases scheduled on same dates for consolidation.
